title: Money Manager Personal Finance App
summary: Desktop personal finance application for tracking income, daily expenses, and budget analytics.
problem: Managing personal budgets manually often leads to unorganized financial tracking and lack of spending insights.
solution: Created an Object-Oriented Java application with a graphical interface for transaction logging, category budget caps, and financial summaries.
features: Income and expense categorization with automated balance calculations
Monthly budget cap warnings and interactive visual graphs
Data persistence saving transactions securely to local storage
